lag_7: sales(target_date-7) iff date<=issue_date and observed, else NULL
lag_14: sales(target_date-14) iff date<=issue_date and observed, else NULL
lag_28: sales(target_date-28) iff date<=issue_date and observed, else NULL
lag_availability: one boolean per lag, true iff observed, including sales=0
rolling_mean_7: mean observed sales in [issue_date-6,issue_date]; NULL if empty
rolling_mean_28: mean observed sales in [issue_date-27,issue_date]; NULL if empty
rolling_std_28: sample stddev of observed sales in [issue_date-27,issue_date], ddof=1; NULL if count<2
missing_history_flag: history_count_28<28, including left boundary of history
series_membership: pair first observed at or before issue_date; never from a future-only vocabulary
precision: PostgreSQL NUMERIC; no cast to float or scale truncation
idempotency: transaction per month, shared historical state locks, session advisory lock shared with bootstrap, code SHA256 and bidirectional EXCEPT content verification; no UPDATE/DELETE
issuance_assumption: end of day: same-day observed sales assumed available; source has no historical arrival timestamps
